highlights: Exactly three mutually exclusive product roles: ADMIN, INSTRUCTOR and STUDENT
Separate admin, instructor and student portals with route guards and role-owned navigation
Course-only public product with no class routes or class navigation
Course quizzes live inside their owning course and can be generated from course PDF/DOCX resources
Standalone exams remain separate and can be generated from instructor-owned PDF/DOCX files
Learning player supports video, PDF, safe DOCX text preview and direct assignment submission
Customer-configurable login background, logo, brand name and theme color
Dark theme uses muted blue-gray separators instead of white borders
Nineteen backend services have separate folders, README ownership notes and unique ports 8080-8098
